title: FNR3 PSP generic-event to AEMS runtime pipeline
confidence: CONFIRMED for control/dataflow and layouts unless individually marked

relocation_context.note: The state-table addresses below are PSP-relocated references targeting program segment 1. Raw pre-relocation offsets are retained for reproducibility.

mapping_key_packer.layout: little-endian 32-bit: +0x00 u16 token/key, +0x02 u8 selector B, +0x03 u8 selector A
mapping_key_packer.note: 0x0049B61C constructs +0x1C through this helper from parsed EVT fields.

behavior: resolves the listener's packed mapping key through 0x004970EC
reads mapping-record +0x0B as the number of 32-bit gameplay-payload words required by this mapping
allocates 4 + payload_words*4 bytes through the registered AEMS allocator
copies the 4-byte mapping key to packet +0x00
copies exactly payload_words words from the generic named-event payload to packet +0x04
submits ownership to 0x004974CC; failed submission frees the packet immediately

state_layout.+0x020..+0x03F: 8 x s32 current/selected admitted-slot indices; -1 means none

fields.+0x00: scheduler time/tick captured from 0x0049B528 (behavior confirmed; exact time-unit name unresolved)
fields.+0x04: u16 sequence/generation value used to order events sharing a time value

behavior: rejects reentrant submission through a global guard
resolves packet +0x00 mapping key through 0x004970EC
retrieves the AEMS group index via 0x00497140 and chooses one of 16 admitted slots with 0x00497364
stores scheduler ordering data, mapping pointer and packet ownership in the selected slot
increments the owning group's active count and records its current slot
if mapping-record byte +0x0A bit 5 is set, immediately invokes the group's processing path at 0x00497E48
release_behavior: frees the owned packet if present
clears the group's current-slot index if this slot was current
decrements the group's active count without allowing it to remain negative

context_layout.+0x04: selected parsed AEMS event/variant object pointer
context_layout.+0x0A: number of 12-byte execution descriptors, derived from selected object byte +0x02 >> 2
context_layout.+0x0B: mapping-record gameplay-payload word count (source for owned packet-copy allocation)
context_layout.+0x0C: owned copy of the mapping/gameplay packet
context_layout.+0x10: start of up to 12 execution descriptors

fields.+0x00: interned event/object token ID (CONFIRMED); 0x0049A5C0 copies this directly to AuSpeechManager request +0x00
fields.+0x04: signed cached index into the global 8-byte {token ID, parsed object pointer} interner table; -1 means unresolved/stale and 0x00496AF0 refreshes it
fields.+0x06: signed optional block displacement; -1 means no extra block displacement
fields.+0x08: u16 byte-range entry selector passed to 0x0049B480

token_cache_dataflow: 0x0049A5C0 uses descriptor +0x04 as an index into the global interner table at 0x005769D0.
It compares the table entry's token ID against descriptor +0x00.
On mismatch it calls 0x00496AF0(token_id), which linearly resolves the correct table index, then caches that index back into descriptor +0x04.
The table entry's parsed object pointer is then used with descriptor +0x08 to decode the selected byte range.
block_displacement: 0x0049B480 returns the selected entry's byte start and byte length.
The parsed object's block scale is (byte +0x07 + 1) << 8.
When descriptor +0x06 != -1, 0x0049A5C0 adds descriptor+0x06 * block_scale to the byte start.
The resulting relative byte start becomes AuSpeechManager request +0x04.

unresolved_boundary: Individual comevt.evt / ancevt.evt / trnevt.evt subscription names and their exact payload-word requirements are external-data facts not recoverable from BOOT.BIN alone.
The semantic names of several mapping-condition fields and execution-descriptor fields remain unresolved.
Exact spoken-clip identity for a given gameplay event requires the corresponding speech .evt/.hdr/.big data or a runtime capture.
provenance: Derived from static disassembly and PSP relocation records in the user-provided ULES00270 debug/review BOOT.BIN.
No executable or commercial resource bytes are committed.

fields.+0x02: packed count/format byte used by parsed sub-object traversal; exact aggregate semantic unresolved
fields.+0x04: relative offset from EVT object base to 0x20-byte generic-event subscription table
fields.+0x08: selector byte A; paired with +0x09 to identify one of 8 registered AEMS groups

subscription_table.string_rebase: entry+0x00 initially contains a relative name offset; 0x0049B61C adds end_of_subscription_table and writes the absolute pointer back in place
mapping_token_resolution: for subscription i, read u16 index = *(evt+0x18+i*2)
read u16 mapping token from evt + mapping_record_offset

secondary_state_array.note: 0x0049ACC0 resets this byte array for every registered EVT object in the selected AEMS group/category. Exact state semantics remain unresolved.

group_registry.duplicate_rule: 0x0049AD50 rejects registration when another installed object has the same +0x08/+0x09 selector-byte pair

mapping_record_model.confidence: CONFIRMED for byte/field uses; probability interpretation at +0x09 is PROBABLE

algorithm: select the registered EVT object by selector bytes
scan the EVT object's +0x18 u16 index list
for each index, address evt + index*4 and compare the record's first u16 against the requested mapping token

fields.+0x02: u16 admitted-packet lifetime/expiry window in the scheduler's time units (CONFIRMED arithmetic; exact time unit unresolved)
fields.+0x04: u16 admission priority/rank used when all 16 scheduler slots are occupied (CONFIRMED ordering behavior)
fields.+0x06: count controlling a leading u16 variable table before the condition-clause region; exact semantic label unresolved
fields.+0x07: count of 3-byte condition clauses evaluated by 0x0049B108 (CONFIRMED)
fields.+0x09: signed random-acceptance threshold: 0x004974CC draws an integer 0..99 using 0x0049AB4C(100,-1) and rejects when threshold < draw (CONFIRMED); -1 rejects all, 0 accepts only draw 0, >=99 accepts all draws
fields.+0x0A: flags; bit 0 affects evaluator behavior and bit 5 forces immediate scheduler processing (CONFIRMED)
fields.+0x0B: number of 32-bit words copied from the generic gameplay-event payload into the AEMS packet (CONFIRMED)

observed_clause_fields.byte +0: condition opcode/value passed as callback argument 1
observed_clause_fields.byte +1: payload-word selector; 0 means no payload word, nonzero selects a 32-bit word from the copied gameplay payload
observed_clause_fields.byte +2: present in each 3-byte clause; exact consumer meaning not yet proven

condition_callback.note: 0x0049B108 calls the registered +0x04 callback and records positive vs negative results into separate bitmasks. The exact original semantic names of these two callbacks remain unproven.

scheduler_use.expiry: 0x00497364 compares current_scheduler_time - slot_time against existing mapping +0x02 and releases expired slots
scheduler_use.priority: when no free/expired slot exists, 0x00497364 compares the new mapping +0x04 priority with existing slots in the same group to choose an eviction candidate
scheduler_use.threshold: 0x0049AB4C(100,-1) returns a PRNG-backed bounded integer 0..99; 0x004974CC rejects when signed mapping+0x09 < random_draw, proving +0x09 is a probabilistic acceptance threshold

registration_behavior: 0x00496F20 finds/inserts the parsed object in the sorted interner table.
It writes the current next-token value to entry +0x00 and the object pointer to +0x04.
It increments next-token and used-count and returns the assigned token ID.
AuSpeechManager stores that returned token in each 16-byte speech-bank record +0x00.
global_event_object_interner.implication: The same token namespace crosses the parser, decoder context, AEMS request and AuSpeechManager speech-bank lookup.

behavior: 0x0049A860 advances a multiword PRNG state and returns a 32-bit pseudorandom value.
0x0049AB4C(range, exclude) scales the PRNG high 16 bits into 0..range-1.
When exclude == -1, it returns that bounded result directly.
The admission path calls 0x0049AB4C(100,-1), therefore the admission draw is exactly 0..99.
